# IELTS band calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/ielts-overall/

Calculate an overall IELTS band from Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking scores using the official averaging and half-band rounding rule.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Scores of 6.5, 6.5, 5.0 and 7.0 average 6.25 and round to an overall band of 6.5.

## Limits and checks

Enter awarded component bands in half-band steps. An overall score does not replace a university’s individual skill requirements.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
